I will apply one and a half bags of subsidized NPK fertilizer and some cow manure to this rented plot because the soil in our part of the North East is sandy and tired, and I need to get a reasonable harvest from the land. I will sow my own kept maize seed since improved seed is too expensive for a plot I do not own, and I will not use chemicals or irrigation because we depend on the rains and pull weeds by hand. My children and I will do most of the planting, weeding, and harvesting, but I will hire two young men for five days to help with the heaviest work when the rains come.
